# mtncloud_mos_object (Data Source)

Reads one object in a MOS bucket: its size, ETag, metadata, retention and ACL, and its content when asked.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_mos_object" "config" {
  bucket          = "acme-website"
  key             = "config.json"
  include_content = true
}

output "env" {
  value = jsondecode(data.mtncloud_mos_object.config.content).env
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.
- `key` (String) The object's name.

### Optional

- `include_content` (Boolean) Also read the content, for objects up to 1 MiB. Defaults to `false`. The content is stored in Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `acl` (String) Its canned ACL, or `custom`.
- `content` (String) The content as text, when `include_content` is set and it is valid UTF-8.
- `content_base64` (String) The content, base64-encoded, when `include_content` is set.
- `etag` (String) The ETag.
- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<key>`.
- `last_modified` (String) When it was last written (RFC 3339).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Its user metadata.
- `retain_until` (String) When its retention ends (RFC 3339), or null.
- `retention_mode` (String) `GOVERNANCE` when retention holds it, or null.
- `size` (Number) The size in bytes.
